info.description: Open-weight offline speech and audio model from NVIDIA under OpenMDW-1.1: a hybrid mixture-of-experts Speech-Augmented Language Model with about 4.3B active parameters (including the audio encoder). Transcribes 40 languages and handles recordings up to one hour with a 65,536-token context; also does speech translation, contextual and speaker-attributed transcription, timestamp prediction, language identification and audio question answering. Audio and text in, text out (optional word timestamps). Released in BF16, FP8 and NVFP4; reasoning toggled via chat template enable_thinking. No hosted API endpoint or official price found.

zh.description: NVIDIA 开放权重的离线语音与音频模型，许可证 OpenMDW-1.1：混合 MoE 架构的语音增强语言模型，激活参数约 4.3B（含音频编码器）。支持 40 种语言转写，可处理最长 1 小时录音，上下文 65,536 tokens；还支持语音翻译、上下文转写、说话人转写、时间戳预测、语种识别和音频问答。输入音频和文本，输出文本（可选词级时间戳）。提供 BF16、FP8、NVFP4 版本；推理通过聊天模板 enable_thinking 开关。未找到托管 API 端点或官方价格。
